narratives.Overview:
## Bound contract (locked v5 + Astra F1/F2)

Issue body is locked v5. Binding arc: recut body note 5560842284; Stop 1 5560964229; critic Astra 5561005528; successor lean 5561016491; verified-claims 5561018593; synthesis accepted 5561018721. Older critic 5559958873 / premature lean 5559969396 / synthesis 5559971786 are SUPERSEDED. Do not implement dest-root ritual/scope swap. Do not skip-on-allow. Do not treat worktree_path as a Grok dest.

Product base is origin/master after rebase. Critic evidence pin SHA: 04bf3a7097ec8386e20e361ef861cf028522a044.

## Locked v5

- Skip parent verifySessionRitual only when dest is dest-proven, not when evaluateImplementSpawnOccupancy.allow. Dest occupancy consult-only runs first (no mint). Mint and persistSpawnReservation stay last, after parent-root active-scope and intent ceiling.
- Dest-proven skip calls neither verifySessionRitual nor inspectSessionRitual. Dest-unproven keeps verifySessionRitual. inspectSessionRitual is occupancy-deny decoration only, not a conjunct on dest-proven.
- Dest-proven fail-closed: destPath set, exists, isLinkedWorktreePath, both git-common-dirs resolve, same repo, not live occupied, not already reserved. Unproven common-dir does not skip.
- On Grok, occupancy destPath, dest-proven destPath, persist dest-lock, and host launch are the same field: tool_input.cwd. worktree_path / worktreePath / worktree are occupancy-deny (invalid extra dest), not a second dest. isolation=worktree with cwd is both-set occupancy-deny. isolation=worktree without cwd is destination-missing. Drop the ritual-deny OR. Tests: cwd dest-proven plus worktree_path (same or different) occupancy-deny, no skip, no dest-lock; worktree_path alone occupancy-deny, no skip, no dest-lock.
- Grok occupancy consult also fails closed when kind=path and dest does not exist as a directory: occupancy deny, no skip, no dest-lock.
- Pathless isolation=worktree on reroot hosts does not skip.
- Skill recut includes swarm Phase 0 destination-field list (core-phase-0.md): Grok implement spawn is cwd only. isolation=worktree / worktree_path stay on reroot hosts. host-grok-build.md names cwd, deny class, CLI --cwd last-resort after that deny, no dual-launch. Do not advertise worktree_path.
- Occupancy-refused on the contended primary is why session:start --rearm is the wrong recovery, not a spawn skip. Keep spawn write-gate occupancy hardcoded allow.
- Skip denies when resolved parent identity is none.
- Parent must not author dest ritual-state. Dest-lock / incarnation stays.
- Parent-root active-scope stays. Capability-mode implement spawn stays read-only-deny.
- Child still ritualizes dest before product writes.
- Slice B is #4219, blocked by this issue. Not required to close this issue.

## Astra F1 (accept-into-contract)

Early dest-proven consult is a snapshot; persist/reservation-conflict remains the final launch refusal. Two successful consults, only one successful persist/launch. Scope/intent denial after consult: zero mint, zero persist.

## Astra F2 (accept-into-contract)

Grok missing/invalid-destination recovery text must advertise cwd and must not prescribe worktree_path or pathless isolation. Reroot-host recovery may keep its alternatives.

## Dropped (do not implement)

- Dest-root ritual/scope swap.
- Skip-on-allow (skip when occupancy allow rather than dest-proven).
- Occupancy-refused as a spawn skip.
- Capability-mode punch / PRIMARY_CLAIM_EXCEPTIONS expansion.
- worktree_path as a Grok dest.
- Slice B / #4219.
- Take over #4137. Reopen/merge closed PR 4217. Touch #4220 leftover PR 4222.

## Native unlock

Dest-proven skip of parent verifySessionRitual. On Grok, one dest field (tool_input.cwd) for occupancy, dest-proven, persist, and launch.

## File scope

packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts; packages/core/src/session/spawn-occupancy.ts and tests; content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/references/core-phase-0.md; content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/references/host-grok-build.md; CHANGELOG.md (append-only).
